verdict.rationale: A SaaS email client with public docs could plausibly publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. However, probes returned HTTP 404 for both /llms.txt and the markdown docs endpoint. The evidence shows only ordinary human-oriented docs pages, which are not agent-oriented docs. The MCP client integrations are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
